name: Raycasting with Transfer Function and Shading
aliases: Front-to-back volume raycasting with gradient-based diffuse shading
definition: A fragment shader performing front-to-back volume raycasting. It uses a 1D transfer function texture, gradient-based diffuse shading, and jittered ray stepping to render a volume defined by 3D textures.
summary: Raycasting with Transfer Function and Shading renders volumes using front-to-back compositing, 1D transfer functions, and gradient-based diffuse shading to distinguish itself from basic ray marching.
